summary: This is a routine Form 6-K submission by Vale S.A., a Brazilian foreign private issuer, filed with the SEC under the Exchange Act for May 2026. The filing consists solely of cover page information, signatures by the Director of Investor Relations, and an embedded image (a company logo). No material special-situation corporate event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change—is described. The filing appears to be a periodic report with no substantive disclosure of a transformative event, making it ineligible for special-situation classification.
